# KAT Renovation

> KAT Renovation LLC is a licensed and insured New York City general contractor that renovates apartments for landlords, multifamily owners and condo owners, with fixed price proposals and a 45 day target construction timeline (measured from permit issuance and site access; not a guarantee). It also does retail and restaurant buildouts.
